verdict.rationale: The axis applies because a law firm could offer company formation. The evidence shows only that the firm lists start-ups among its clients and helps startups standardize key documents. Its Prarambh incubator is a legaltech program limited to businesses registered for at least a year, so it is not a formation service. Nothing documents incorporation work (charter, bylaws, initial board consents, founder stock purchase) as part of any startup or emerging-companies practice.
